name: AudioMuse-AI
tagline: Automatic playlist generation for self-hosted music servers
description: Automatic playlist generation for self-hosted music servers. Analyses your library locally to group tracks by how they sound. Works with Navidrome, Jellyfin, LMS, Lyrion, Emby and Plex. GitHub: [NeptuneHub/AudioMuse-AI](https://github.com/NeptuneHub/AudioMuse-AI)
